user.title: OSM Parking
user.description: Choose a destination entity from the compatible entities detected below. A compatible entity must expose numeric latitude + longitude, or lat + lon/lng attributes. Parking refreshes when the destination changes or Home Assistant starts.

data_description.destination_entity: Only compatible entities are pre-listed. Expected attributes: latitude + longitude, or lat + lon/lng. Example: latitude 50.9385, longitude 6.9829.

error.invalid_destination_entity: The selected entity is unavailable or does not currently expose valid coordinates.

abort.already_configured: This destination entity is already configured.

init.title: OSM Parking options
init.description: Configure the search and optional regional providers. Public key-free providers are automatic. Credentialed providers are used only when enabled, their credentials are present, and the destination is inside their coverage.

data_description.destination_entity: Only compatible entities are pre-listed. Expected attributes: latitude + longitude, or lat + lon/lng. Example: latitude 50.9385, longitude 6.9829.
data_description.golemio_api_key: Optional free developer key from api.golemio.cz/api-keys. Used only for destinations in Prague.
data_description.tfnsw_api_key: Optional Transport for NSW Open Data API key. Used only for destinations in NSW.
data_description.tdx_client_id: Optional TDX Client ID from the TDX member center. Client ID and Client Secret are both required.
data_description.tdx_client_secret: Optional TDX Client Secret. It is stored in the Home Assistant config entry and redacted from diagnostics.

error.invalid_destination_entity: The selected entity is unavailable or does not currently expose valid coordinates.
